answer: A single pearl checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so someone cannot recover it by rotating identities. Forging 112 aliases thus costs 180 bonds held for 3 days each, plus the zephyr attestations those aliases can never earn. Each identity must lock a bond, called a delta, before it can post or attest. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
